title: Treat blank optional env booleans as unset
description: Context: Docker Compose reads .env values before container startup. .env.example documents optional booleans such as SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPS_ONLY= with an empty value. Acceptance: blank optional env values for session cookie HTTPS setting behave like unset/default configuration while invalid non-boolean strings still fail. Verification: targeted config tests and API startup/health check pass.
close_reason: Fixed blank optional env boolean handling for SESSION_COOKIE_HTTPS_ONLY by normalizing empty string to unset/None before pydantic bool parsing. Added regression coverage and made API basics test robust against local REDIS_URL env. Verified: uv run pytest tests/test_api_basics.py -q (13 passed); uv run ruff check src tests (passed); docker compose up -d --build api worker frontend (started); endpoint checks /api/health, /api/session, /api/models, frontend /health all returned 200.

title: Add guided repository evidence investigation
description:

Expanded scope per user request: add default-disabled author contribution scoping for guided analysis. Researched larsencundric/git-standup-cli; it is a small npm wrapper around git log --all/--author plus changed files. Chosen design: custom Python contribution scope service using bounded git commands, no npm runtime dependency, optional analysisAuthor request field, restrict repository investigation tools/final context to author-touched files when enabled.
Fixed reviewer finding: ContributionAnalysisService now post-filters parsed git log commits with case-insensitive fixed-string author containment before accepting commits or touched files. Added regression test proving author='.*' does not include fake Alice commits/files. Verification: RED uv run pytest tests/test_contribution_analysis_service.py -q failed on new regression before fix (1 failed, 4 passed); GREEN same command passed (5 passed); uv run ruff check src tests passed.

GREEN evidence: `uv run pytest tests/test_contribution_analysis_service.py tests/test_repository_api.py tests/test_generation_api.py -q` passed (44 passed); `uv run ruff check src tests` passed.
close_reason: Implemented opt-in guided repository evidence investigation plus robust author contribution scoping. Added typed investigation schemas/prompts, safe bounded repo tools, LiteLLM JSON extraction, worker integration/fallback, hosted token hardening, git-standup-style contribution analysis with literal name/email post-filtering, settings/API/frontend controls, and regression tests. Repomix latest checked via `npm view repomix version` = 1.14.0; ingestion service uses `npx --yes repomix@latest` as primary strategy, with gitingest fallback when npx is unavailable and tree-sitter-analyzer for structural file summaries. Added explicit multi-stage local AI analysis pipeline: `ProjectClassifier` detects project type/languages/frameworks/package managers/entrypoints; `RankedContextBuilder` applies robust ignores and scores files using profile hints; `RepositoryIngestionService.build_context()` now classifies -> selects relevant files -> tree-sitter-analyzes top files -> packs selected files with Repomix or falls back to ranked text context. Verified with `uv run pytest tests/test_api_basics.py tests/test_analysis_tools.py tests/test_context_ranking.py tests/test_ingestion_service.py tests/test_project_classifier.py tests/test_multistage_ingestion.py tests/test_resume_generation.py -q` = 20 passed and `uv run ruff check src tests` = all checks passed.
Expanded staged analysis pipeline to support major code languages. `ProjectClassifier` now detects Python, JS/TS, Java, Go, Rust, C/C++, C#, Kotlin, PHP, Ruby, SQL, HTML/CSS, Markdown, YAML/JSON, shell/PowerShell, Swift, Scala, R, Lua, Elixir and emits relevant globs. Ranking now scores these languages and common high-value paths (controllers/handlers/middleware/cmd/internal/pkg/contracts/migrations), plus frameworks including React/Vite/Next/Angular/Vue/Svelte/FastAPI/Django/Flask/LiteLLM/Spring Boot/Gin/Actix. Verified with `uv run pytest ... -q` = 22 passed, `uv run ruff check src tests` = all checks passed, and `uv tree --depth 1 --outdated` shows direct deps current.

Acceptance: Decide canonical runtime path, update Docker/docs/requirements or uv install flow accordingly, and verify container startup path.

close_reason: Aligned deployment and OSS cleanup. Updated uv/src Docker runtime, Docker Compose, frontend nginx image, .dockerignore coverage, .env.example, README/CONTRIBUTING, and removed stale legacy app.py, requirements.txt, env.example.yaml, templates/, static/, and tools/. Verified: uv run pytest -q (64 passed), uv run ruff check src tests (All checks passed), npm run test:run (9 passed), npm run build (succeeded), docker compose config (succeeded), docker build --target runtime -t gitresume-api:test . (succeeded), docker build -t gitresume-frontend:test frontend (succeeded).

title: Expand OSS-first repository analysis evidence pipeline
description:
Context: User requested GitResume repository analysis pipeline expansion on branch migrate.
Problem: Ingestion and context building should use OSS-first tools (Repomix, gitingest, tree-sitter, networkx, tiktoken) to produce evidence-backed prompt context for large/polyglot codebases.
Acceptance: Tests first for Repomix command options/modes, gitingest filters/excludes, structured build_context evidence, and prompt guardrails. Implement small reviewable changes without committing. Verification commands from user run and reported.
close_reason: Implemented OSS-first repository analysis expansion with tests first. Added Repomix selected-context flags and metadata/git-log command modes, filtered gitingest helper options, structured build_context evidence keys, tree-sitter option expansion, and evidence-backed prompt guardrails. Verified: focused pytest 9 passed; broad pytest 43 passed; ruff check passed.

title: Complete Taskiq generation job flow
description:
Context: User requested completion of GitResume generation job functionality behind Taskiq + Redis Streams/SSE slice on branch migrate.
Problem: Worker currently emits only a starting event and does not validate, clone, ingest, generate, or clean up.
Acceptance: Add request githubToken alias support without persisting token; add checkout service with safe token clone URL handling and cleanup; complete run_generation lifecycle with Redis events/state, repo access validation, checkout, ingestion, LiteLLM generation, completion/failure handling, cleanup and Redis close; broker import works without REDIS_URL; add requested tests first and preserve existing tests/ruff.
Verification: uv run pytest targeted suites and uv run ruff check src tests.
close_reason: Completed generation worker flow: added githubToken schema handling, checkout service with cleanup, full validate-clone-analyze-generate worker lifecycle, broker safe import, and tests. Verified with targeted pytest (9 passed), requested suite pytest (37 passed), and ruff check (All checks passed).

title: Implement generation jobs and SSE events slice
description:
Context: Next backend slice for GitResume on branch migrate.
Problem: Need OSS-backed generation job/state/event APIs using Taskiq, Redis Streams, and SSE with tests first.
Acceptance: Add typed generation schemas, Redis-backed state/event service, Taskiq job skeleton, /api/generations endpoints, dependencies via uv, and tests covering schema serialization, stream replay, API enqueue/status, and SSE terminal event.
Verification: uv run pytest tests/test_generation*.py -q; uv run pytest tests/test_api_basics.py tests/test_analysis_tools.py tests/test_context_ranking.py tests/test_ingestion_service.py tests/test_project_classifier.py tests/test_multistage_ingestion.py tests/test_resume_generation.py tests/test_generation*.py -q; uv run ruff check src tests
close_reason: Implemented generation jobs/events backend slice with schemas, Redis Stream state/event service, Taskiq dispatcher/worker skeleton, SSE endpoints, dependencies, and tests. Verified: generation tests 7 passed; targeted regression suite 29 passed; ruff check passed.
